claim: Which residues assign nucleotide specificity in SCS beta subunits
finding: Gln-20beta plus backbone atoms provide guanine specificity; Arg-54beta binds the gamma-phosphate. No other residue is assigned to base discrimination.
context: pig GTP-specific SCS, 2.1 A, GTP and GDP complexes
conf: High. One determinant only, assigned from the GTP-bound side.

claim: Pro at beta-20 indicates ATP specificity
finding: T. aquaticus SCS has Pro20beta and prefers GDP/GTP; a water substitutes for the Gln amide. Uses both nucleotides.
context: T. aquaticus recombinant enzyme, activity assays plus GDP-Mn structure
conf: High. Directly breaks the Pro20beta -> ATP inference.

claim: How an ADP/ATP-preferring SCS reads the adenine
finding: Computed here: adenine contacted by Val44, Lys46, Glu99, Ala100, Ala101, Thr102, Ile104, Leu212; Pro20beta makes no contact (4.22 +/- 0.15 A).
context: E. coli SCS, dual specificity, prefers ADP/ATP
conf: Moderate. 3.3 A resolution; E. coli is not strictly ATP-specific.

claim: scsC belongs to the ATP-specific beta lineage of animals and fungi
finding: The A-beta/G-beta duplication is placed early in multicellular eukaryotes; pigeon A-beta and G-beta are 54% identical, the same range as scsC vs pig G-SCS (54.5%).
context: pigeon, mouse, human, pig, C. elegans sequences
conf: Moderate. Family labels may not extend to an amoebozoan duplication.

finding: "the enzyme purified from growing D. discoideum is a GTP-utilizing enzyme"; alpha subunit is single copy and developmentally regulated.
context: D. discoideum growing cells, purified enzyme
conf: High for the preparation, silent on which beta subunit was present.

finding: Crude extracts phosphorylate p36 with ATP or GTP; partial purification keeps GTP activity and loses ATP activity.
context: D. discoideum crude membranes and partially purified p36
conf: Moderate. Phosphoenzyme assay, not steady-state kinetics.

claim: Only GTP supports SCS phosphoenzyme formation in Dictyostelium
finding: p38 in crude mitochondrial fractions is phosphorylated by either ATP or GTP.
conf: Moderate. Crude fraction, phosphorylation assay only.

citation: This work (AlphaFold AF-Q869S7-F1 v6 on PDB 2FP4)
claim: scsB carries the guanine-reading Gln in the nucleotide pocket
finding: 370/392 CA pairs, 0.98 A core RMSD; Gln46 side chain 2.59 A from the guanine O6/N1/N2/N7 edge versus 2.58 A for pig Gln20beta. pLDDT 95.0.
context: model superposed on the GTP complex
conf: Moderate-high as a prediction. Model, not an experimental structure; no nucleotide was docked.

citation: This work (AlphaFold AF-Q55AI5-F1 v6 on PDB 2FP4)
finding: 353/393 CA pairs, 1.30 A core RMSD; Pro54 5.68 A from the guanine, matching Thermus Pro20beta (5.77 +/- 0.23 A). Arg142 (= pig Ala108beta) sits 3.82 A from the base.
context: model superposed on the GTP complex
conf: Low-moderate. The same geometry occurs in an enzyme that prefers GTP.

claim: Specificity can be predicted from the determinant residues
finding: Six of seven sites separate the strictly specific enzymes, none separates once the two dual enzymes are scored by measured preference. One independent origin of measured GTP specificity, two of ATP/ADP use.
context: pig/human/mouse SUCLG2 and SUCLA2, yeast Lsc2, E. coli, T. aquaticus
conf: High as a statement of limits.

claim: Only one beta subunit is present in growing cells
finding: Vegetative-cell median TPM: scsA 590, scsB 313, scsC 236, all top 4% of expressed genes; scsB/scsC ratio 1.33.
conf: Moderate. mRNA not protein; single dataset; baseline experiment.

finding: scsC GO:0004775 IBA+IEA, GO:0005524 IEA, stale GO:0003674 ND. scsB GO:0004776 IBA+IEA, NOT|enables GO:0004775 IBA, both GO:0005524 and GO:0005525 IEA. The only Dictyostelium IDA (GO:0004776, PMID 8448193) is on the alpha subunit.
conf: High as a record; no experimental code supports specificity on either beta.
